name: HotSeat
tagline: Three AI advisors. No corporate garbage. Real talk.
description: HotSeat is a multi-persona AI advisory app built for solo developers and small teams. Three distinct AI characters — each with a unique voice, worldview, and specialty — give you brutally honest feedback on your work, decisions, and ideas. No sycophancy. No fluff. The boardroom you actually need. Built local-first on Android/Termux with Ollama. Configurable personas, extensible architecture.
features: Three distinct AI advisor personas with unique voices and specialties
Brutally honest feedback — no corporate sycophancy
Local-first — runs on Android/Termux, no cloud required
Configurable persona system — swap or add characters
Designed for solo devs, founders, and small teams
pricing_model: One-time setup fee or monthly SaaS — custom pricing per engagement
estimated_roi_per_business: Replaces expensive consultants for early-stage decision making
